## Overview

The study examines AI curriculum materials on Teachers Pay Teachers using an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design. It combines a description of available resources with regression and qualitative analysis to investigate patterns associated with their popularity. The work connects educational data mining with questions about how teachers access and adopt AI teaching materials.
